title: Sections without a published VOTA voting log
explanation: Of 72 section entries without a regular voting log, 41 overseas sections were officially not installed, 29 overseas sections publish tabulation-system logs instead, and 2 domestic sections publish results without a voting log. The 31 installed sections have 1,285 presidential ballots in published official bulletins. Their individual casting times cannot be assigned from these published section logs.

sections.explanation: Official BU/RDV/signature files are published, but the section metadata does not advertise a voting log. The bulletin confirms votes exist; their before/after split is unavailable from published voting logs.
